schema: members: name -> file, status nonsegmented (ccv1 -O) and segmented (sccv1 -O), note
compiler: v1 (02/11/83) with OLD_D63; v1 with OLD_D2N, D2L, D2F or D2W (each alone) is not nearer (measured 2026-11-18). The rest differs where the original frees an idle word register at the end of a condition (shipped-like) and keeps pairs (v1-like); see host/OLDCC_LOG.md 2026-11-18.

util.o.note: error() writes sizeof("\r\nFatal system error: ") bytes: the NUL too.

key.o.note: kycopy needs the casts (int *) in wdcopy (the reload of the parameters).

node.o.note: btremove: `tp->t_off != 0 ? ip2 : ip1` (the plain `tp->t_off ?` takes r6 for the test, segmented).

buf.o.note: bfwrite: `if (off != 0)` (with `if (off)` the segmented code takes rr2 for the trailer bytes).

supp.o.note: nonsegmented: freefile, close(fp->f_audfd): the original takes r6 for the value, v1 r3. Forms tried: != 0, (*fp), register fp, bfignor(fp->f_fileid).

read.o.note: isread: the original keeps lock in r2 at the else label and takes r3 (rr4) for openp, v1 forgets at the label. Forms tried: branches swapped, && forms, goto, != 0.

audit.o.note: isaudit AUDSTOP, close(filep->f_audfd): nonsegmented the original takes r3 for the value (v1 r6), segmented it loads into r7 through rr4 directly (v1 copies). Forms tried: one && condition, != 0, < 0, a cast.

open.o.note: isopen: the magic read as `(char)*(unsigned char *)dictp` and `(char)((unsigned char *)dictp)[1]` (the cast makes v1 load dictp again, as the original). Nonsegmented open: isexit takes rr2 for `filep->f_fileid` behind `!(openp->o_mode & ISEXCLLOCK)` and r3 for the ?: of isstat2 (the original frees the word register at the end of the condition, segmented it keeps the pair). Forms tried: host/OLDCC_LOG.md.

btree.o.note: btdelitem: `bad:` inside the error branch. Nonsegmented open: btsearch `openp->o_flags |= 020` behind `r == 0 && mode == 2 && bp->bf_level == 0` takes r2 (bp) as free in the original, v1 keeps it (OLD_D3); segmented the original keeps the pair. No source form found (host/OLDCC_LOG.md 2026-11-18).

item.o.note: itcompare FLOATTYPE: OLD_D63. itpress: the leading compression loop as a goto loop; `(int)it_dupnum` for stint. Nonsegmented open: `bycmpr(..., kp->k_len)` copies kp into r4 in the original (v1 r2). Segmented open: itunpack `it_leadcnt`/`it_trailcnt = ... ? *p++ & 0377 : 0` stores through rr2 after the arm loaded the old p into rr2 (a bug of the old scodgen: the value goes into the buffer); itpress takes rr2 (kp) as free behind the bit tests.

build.o.note: isaddindex in the original's order (the .extern order shows it): the recovery block inside the loop head (`done:`), `bad:` at the end; isbuild stores the magic through `(unsigned char *)dictp` (the original loads dictp again for the second byte); btrecover with two `if`s.
